title: 第5章 杨戬谁准你动我的东西第6章 宿主基础系统就不基础
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 江盼一口气跑回分配给自己的那间偏僻小院，背靠着门板大口喘气，腿软得几乎站不住。
【吓、吓死我了……】她抚着砰砰狂跳的心口，【那眼神……简直像要把我生吞活剥了还得嚼碎了咽下去！
还没等她缓过劲，脑海里那冰冷的机械音如同丧钟般敲响：
惩罚机制启动——目标人物恶念值瞬间飙升，攻击性提高300%。
附加惩罚：引动‘小五行灵炎劫雷’一道，惩戒宿主办事不力。
江盼猛地跳起来，脸都气红了，“恶念值飙升？！
哪吒那恶念值本来就没下降过！”
“再飙升他还不得直接把我剁成鱼蓉？！
我现在这修为一道雷下来直接灰飞烟灭了吧？！”
扣积分行不行？或者换个惩罚？电击？腹泻一个月？什么都行！
江盼急得团团转，眼眶都红了，差点哭出来。
江盼绝望地哀嚎一声，求生本能让她像只无头苍蝇一样在狭小的院里乱窜，试图找个地方躲藏。
桌子底下？柜子里面？等等，这是神话世界，天雷会劈透的吧？！
窗外原本晴朗的天空瞬间乌云密布，隐隐有雷光闪烁，沉闷的威压笼罩下来。
江盼抱头鼠窜，情急之下看到墙角那个有一整个人高的、装饰用的青瓷花瓶，也顾不上那么多了，手脚并用地就往里爬。
她刚把自己勉强塞进花瓶，只露出个脑袋在外面——
content_en:
Jiang Pan ran back to the remote courtyard assigned to him in one breath. He leaned against the door panel and gasped for air. His legs were so weak that he could hardly stand.
[S-scared me to death...] She stroked her beating heart, [That look... It was as if he wanted to eat me alive and have to chew it up and swallow it!
Nezha is so scary!
Before she could recover, the cold mechanical sound in her mind sounded like a death knell:
[System: Warning!
Mission "Drug"
Not completed within the stipulated time.
The punishment mechanism is activated - the target character's evil thoughts instantly soar, and their aggressiveness increases by 300%.
Additional punishment: triggering the 'Small Five Elements Spirit Flame Tribulation Thunder' to punish the host for incompetence in doing things.
"What?!"
Jiang Pan jumped up suddenly, his face turned red with anger, "The level of evil thoughts has soared?!
Also, there is thunder? !
System, are you playing with me? !
Nezha’s evil thoughts value has never dropped! "
"If it keeps soaring, he can't just chop me into mincemeat?!
And what the hell is Tianlei? !
My current cultivation level will be completely wiped out by a thunderbolt, right? ! "
[System: Punishment has taken effect.
Target character's evil thoughts value: 400% (temporary).
The thunder will come in ten seconds.
10...]
"Wait!
Let’s discuss it!
Is it okay to deduct points? Or change the punishment? Electric shock? Have diarrhea for a month? Anything goes!
No thunder! "
Jiang Pan was so anxious that his eyes were red and he almost cried.
【9……8……】
"Dog system!
You are cruel! "
Jiang Pan wailed in despair, her survival instinct causing her to scurry around the small courtyard like a headless fly, trying to find a place to hide.
Under the table? Inside the cabinet? Wait, this is a mythical world, thunder can break through it, right? !
【7……6……】
The originally clear sky outside the window was suddenly covered with dark clouds, with faint flashes of lightning, and a dull pressure shrouded it.
【5…4…】
"It's over, it's over!"
Jiang Pan scurried away with his head in his hands. In his desperation, he saw the decorative celadon vase in the corner that was as tall as a person. He didn't care about it anymore and crawled in using his hands and feet.
【3…2…】
She had just forced herself into the vase, with only her head exposed——
【1.
Punishment execution.
"Boom - click!"
